title: Castelion feature card
description: A page-wide photo card with 4px corners, cream type laid straight onto the picture: a bold four-line title top left and a justified lead top right (stacked on phones). The card rises into place as it scrolls in, its title lines slide out of masks and the lead fades up; behind its foot a navy band starts, opened by two thin page-colour hairlines.
notes: the empty card is a sky wash (navy into the highlight blue) in a dark scope so the cream text stays legible; pass media for a real photo
the navy band behind the card's foot uses bg-secondary and flows into castelion-statement
scroll-driven CSS; static and reduced-motion views show everything in place
name: castelion-feature-card

props.name: title
props.description: the card's title, one entry per desktop line

props.name: lead
props.description: the justified lead beside the title

props.name: media

props.description: what the photo shows, for screen readers while the slot is empty
